info.title: Game Server GM API
info.description: JSON API for GM tools. Errors are Problem Details with a `code` (error-code catalog). Cookie-authenticated mutations need the `X-CSRF-Token` header from GET /gm/v1/auth/csrf; GM commands need an `X-Request-Id` UUID and a `reason`. Operations carry `x-gm-*` keys for generic consoles: `x-gm-permission`, `x-gm-csrf`, `x-gm-kind`, `x-gm-operation`, `x-gm-target`, `x-gm-confirm` and `x-gm-paged`; body properties may carry `x-gm-options` (an option route name).
